en: "Ah... I-I'm sorry!{w} I didn't mean it like that..."{w}
note: Euratia apologizes for hinting there is no time left (previous row 2803, Isfald's '...Euratia').

en: "It's fine, it's fine!{w} Someday, when I come back, I'll teach you!"{w}
"Okay!"{w}
"I can play the lute, so I'll play along with you, Lady Urna!"{w}
"Then I'll take... hmm, which one should I pick~?{w} Okay, I'll go with the Divine Thunder Harp! Twaaang~"{w}
note: New item name: [JP] = 'Divine Thunder Harp' (not in glossary). [JP]♪ = a twang; ♪ -> '~'.

en: "Ah, Lady Urna, if you hold it like that, the lightning'll..."{w}
"Look ouuuuut!"{w}
"It already struck."{w}
note: [JP]: the lightning has already come down.

en: "S-s-sorry! Who did it hit!?"{w}
"R-Radrecht, heeeere..."{w}
note: Callback to Radrecht's self-introduction gag [JP] (slice 063, SCD17:2727): align that row's wording with this one.

en: "Oh, then never mind."{w}
"Wait, why!?"{w}
"Alllright, let's get started!"{w}
All
note: Glossary name box [JP] = All.

en: "Yeah!"{w}

'Urna wished for a small happiness:
first friends, breathing deep in the earth...'{w}
note: Song lyric in [JP] -> single quotes; line break kept as in the source verse.

en: "Can you hear me, our descendants?{w} I am Isfald."{w}{p}"I greet you on behalf of the Elves, Ogres, Humans, Gnomes and Hobbits."{w}{p}"We have overcome a great ruin, and now we stand here, on this land of Fiur Rade.{w} ...Ngh... Gh...! I'm sor... ry..."{w}
note: Isfald (gender not stated): no pronouns.

en: "Lady Ur... na...{w} Lady Urnaaa... *sob*..."{w}
note: [JP] = a sob.

en: "Say...{w} Even if it meant putting Lady Urna through this...{w} even if it meant losing Orses and Sarijana..."{w}{p}"...were we really meant to survive...?{w} Maybe we should've just gone with Lady Urna..."{w}
note: [JP]: kept as unfinished as in the source ('gone with' = shared her fate; not made explicit). Orses/Sarijana without honorifics (gender not established, lead convention).

en: "Hey, old man!{w} Don't you... say stuff like that...{w} You can't say that...!!"{w}{p}"The lives we've got now...{w} are lives Lady Urna saved by trading herself for them...!"{w}{p}"We're gonna live on, no matter what...!!"{w}
"Th-this...! These words of ours!{w} You descendants who are listening.{w} No matter how much time passes, you must never, ever forget them!"{w}
"Our mother -- the place where we were born -- isn't some 'Fiur Rade'!!"{w}
note: [JP] (dismissive) rendered as 'some'; quotes mark the scorned name.

en: "It's Lady Urna's warm embrace...{w} It's Urna Rade.{w} We were loved... this much..."{w}
note: Answers Domanaya's line: the land they were born in is Lady Urna's bosom, Urna Rade.

en: "But there is no need to despair!{w} We will surely meet Lady Urna again!{w} We made a promise, at the very end!"{w}
"That's right. Someday, when the time is ripe..."{w}

"Let this royal command go forth from the descendants of our Elven royal house!"{w}{p}"Leave all wealth, power and riches of every kind behind in the land of Fiona, gather at Lady Urna's side with nothing but yourselves, and start everything over!"{w}{p}"The five races, Elves, Ogres, Humans, Gnomes and Hobbits, shall join hands{w} and seek out the shattered Lady Urna."{w}
note: [JP]: [JP] read as the source of the command (the royal descendants will issue it). Could also be read as Isfald issuing it now; uncertain.

en: "And then we'll celebrate with this Yuan Wine...{w} We'll guard it real carefully, we will..."{w}
note: Yuan Wine (glossary).

en: "Please, don't forget, deliver it to Lady Urna!{w} Please, be sure to deliver it...!!"{w}

"We're celebrating Lady Urna's return.{w} Even if we're dead by then, at least get our feelings across to her!"{w}{p}"You can do that, right...?{w} I don't even know your faces, but you're my Hobbit brothers and sisters!"{w}
note: [JP] (siblings) -> 'brothers and sisters' (descendants of unknown gender). 'to her' restored: the feelings are for Lady Urna's return.

en: "This Fiur Rade is now a land ruled by Fiona, the Zefkaka."{w}{p}"You won't be able to live happy days as you did before.{w} If you ever run into trouble in this land..."{w}{p}"If ever again an unprecedented crisis brought by the hand of the gods should befall us, turn to the Four Sages."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'Fiona, the Zefkaka'.

en: "Omshokopo, once known as Omsis of Wind."{w}
note: [JP] on the Four Sages dropped (no honorific for sages of unestablished gender; kept parallel for all four).

en: "Radrecht, once known as Rades of Fire."{w}
"Shirinmorin, once known as Shirins of Water."{w}
note: Shirinmorin is female, but 'Lady' omitted to keep the four lines parallel.

en: "Raizam, once known as Raizas of Earth."{w}
"They have been put to sleep by this great upheaval, but once they awaken, they will surely lend you their strength."{w}

"...I pushed myself to make one more stone tablet, but it seems this is as much as I can record."{w}{p}"My fellow Elves. Be noble at all times!{w} Heed the voice of the forest and the whisper of the wind, and walk on with the conviction and pride Lady Urna gave us."{w}
note: [JP] (given) - recipient left as 'us' (the race as a whole).

en: "All you Ogres.{w} Listen, we've got strength, but we ain't too bright."{w}{p}"So don't go showing off the strength Lady Urna gave us, and get along with the other races, y'hear?"{w}
note: Domanaya's rough folksy voice ([JP], ~[JP]).

en: "Humans, everyone.{w} ...Just as Lady Urna loved us, I love all of you, too."{w}{p}"There's nothing I can do from here, but I sincerely pray for your safety."{w}
"What we Gnomes have going for us is the depth of our thought."{w}{p}"Just like Lady Urna, even if the world changes utterly, we of all people must never lose sight of what's precious, mind you."{w}

"Hey there, brothers and sisters. I'm not worried!"{w}{p}"'Cause even if we couldn't do much else, with the quickness we got from Lady Urna, we've come along every bit as far as this lot."{w}{p}"So you, our descendants, can do it too! Hang in there!!"{w}
note: [JP] -> 'brothers and sisters' (as 2862). [JP] = the other races present.

en: "The Vectraim is about to run out.{w} I'm sorry, but this is farewell.{w} Blessings upon you, and upon the Lady Urna of the future!"{w}
note: Vectraim (glossary). [JP] = 'Blessings upon...', repeated in banner 2887.

en: {0E}        *    Blessings upon you!    *        {0F}{w}
note: Centred banner; full-width spaces -> ASCII spaces as in earlier banners; check centring in game.

en: "So you have finally made it here..."{w}{p}"King of Bistel. Though you told them nothing, your descendants and the adventurers who share their resolve have come all this way without straying."{w}{p}"To think there would be hearts that reach out to each other beyond even the hand of the gods..."{w}{p}"King of Bistel, and Muse. You have shown me something fine."{w}{p}"That mural has caught your eye, has it not?{w} Go on. Offer it the name of Mother Earth.{w} You, of all people, should know the name."{w}{p}"Once I have seen that through, I shall take my leave."{w}
note: [JP] read as 'though you (the King) told them nothing'. 'Mother Earth' follows slice 039 ([JP]). The last three pages address the party ([JP]).

en: "Now, show me how this long, long myth ends.{w} Offer the name of Mother Earth."{w}{p}"Once I have seen that through, I shall take my leave."{w}

There is a firmly sealed door.
There is nothing that looks like a keyhole.{w}It is as if it is turning away all who are unworthy.{w}{p}If you gather the divine relics, Ragnastia might make it so you can pass.{w}
note: [JP] = 'those who are unworthy' (lit. without the qualification).
Three-line asterisk box redrawn in ASCII at the source width (46 columns), text centred; check centring in game. Sword of Wrath altar inscription: [JP].

note: Three-line asterisk box redrawn in ASCII at the source width (46 columns), text centred; check centring in game. Shield of Compassion inscription.

Offering a divine relic here would surely give power to the evil spirit deep within the earth.{w}{p}A wise adventurer would do nothing here and move on, but...{w}
note: [JP] = 'the evil spirit deep within the earth' (cf. glossary [JP] 'ancient evil spirit' = Urna).

en: There is an altar.{w}The Earring of Sorrow has been offered here.{w}
Spirit
note: [JP] = Spirit (cf. glossary Snow Spirit).

en: "Contrachio reflects the heart of the Zefkaka."{w}{p}"For some reason, this land has two hearts.{w} Yet both hearts are filled with sorrow."{w}{p}"Before anyone knew it, the water in this Hall of Sorrow had spread wider and wider."{w}
note: New name: [JP] = 'Hall of Sorrow' (room of the Earring of Sorrow). 'Two hearts' = Fiona's and Urna's (lands merged); not made explicit.

en: There is a spring, its water welling up ceaselessly.{w}
Before you stands Urna, with the Kin of Darkness at her command.{w}{p}As you draw near, she seems about to speak, but her words never reach your ears.{w}
note: Kin of Darkness (glossary).

en: "Be cursed...{w} All who stand upon this land... be cursed...!!"{w}{p}"Take my sword of judgment, the wrath of the land, upon yourselves, and perish regretting your own betrayal!!{w} ...Be destroyed!!"{w}
note: [JP] kept figurative ('my sword of judgment'), lower case, not the relic name Sword of Wrath.

en: Something withered in your hands.{w}
"Guh... Gahaah..."{w}
"Not yet... not yet... this fight isn't...{w} I... am... I'm...{w} g-gonna... live... gonna surviv..."{w}
note: Urna slips from imperious [JP] to her casual [JP]; shown as 'I... am...' -> 'I'm... gonna'. Final word cut off as in the source.

en: "Too bad, but you lose.{w} Be a good sport and hand over your power!!"{w}
"Damn it... you lot..."{w}
"That was the deal, wasn't it?{w} Well, blame your own weakness. This is as far as our cooperation goes."{w}
What is going on here?{w}Escapra and the others start closing in on Urna, their supposed ally, intent on killing her.{w}
note: [JP] = to kill with one's own hands; kept at full strength.

en: "Is this... where it ends...?"{w}
